H1.statement: A sufficiently capable external coding model can cross the capability boundary that the tested local CPU model set failed to cross, while Emerald's governance, execution, clean-room verification, and evidence architecture remain unchanged.
H1.testMethod: Substitute model provider with external reference model under frozen Emerald pipeline
H1.falsificationCondition: External reference model fails due to model capability limits or fails verification

H2.statement: The dominant limitation observed in Phases 15-19 is model/inference capability rather than Emerald's execution/governance architecture.
H2.testMethod: Audit governance and verification pipeline performance under reference model execution
H2.falsificationCondition: External model fails due to defects or invalid rejections in Emerald's governance or verifier

providerSelectionCriteria: Coding Capability: Documented strong performance on public SWE benchmarks (SWE-bench Verified >40%)
Structured Output Reliability: Native support for strict JSON Schema output matching action_proposal
Tool-Use Reliability: High fidelity in function calling and closed-schema parameter adherence
Latency: Typical response latency under 15 seconds for 2k-4k context tokens
API Stability: Documented, versioned HTTP API with formal backward-compatibility policies
Cost Transparency: Clear per-token pricing with no opaque minimum commitments
Privacy & Data Retention: Zero-data-retention or enterprise privacy options (code not used for training)
Context Capacity: Minimum 32k context window to comfortably handle workspace contexts
Deterministic Evaluation Capability: Support for seed and temperature: 0.0
Port Compatibility: Direct integration via standard HTTPS behind ModelProviderPort without heavy SDK
